description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveRequestAPI class, which handles REST API endpoints related to employee leave requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and listing leave requests, with detailed validation, permissions checks, and data modeling. The class uses traits for common functionality, supports different response models, and defines OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Leave\Api\EmployeeLeaveRequestAPI
classes.description: API class handling leave request operations such as retrieval, listing, creation, updating within the OrangeHRM system. Implements CRUD endpoints, validation, permission checks, and supports response models for detailed or summary views.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave request by ID. Supports detailed or default response models. Checks access permissions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists leave requests with optional filters such as date range, status, subunit, employee number. Handles pagination, sorting, and access control.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new leave request for an employee, assigns leave via LeaveAssignmentService, returns the created leave request in specified model format.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing leave request's status based on allowed actions, performing permission and status checks.
